visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a stage where a bearded man in a light green short-sleeved button-down shirt is speaking. He gestures with both hands in front of a large screen displaying green tropical leaves. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional presentation venue. (2) A transition cut shows a young woman with short hair, wearing a black T-shirt and white pants, standing in a large exhibition hall. She waves her hands enthusiastically towards a massive LED screen showing a 3D architectural garden. The floor is grey and polished, reflecting the overhead hall lights. (3) Jason, the CEO, appears on stage wearing a dark blazer over a blue shirt and jeans, riding a black electric scooter from left to right. He has a joyful expression and is wearing a headset microphone. The background screen shows people walking in a modern green-filled environment. (4) A sequence of presentation slides follows, showing statistical bar charts in shades of green indicating percentages like 44%, 48%, and 60% for renewable energy. Another slide displays a collection of magazine logos including TIME and Forbes, alongside sustainability award badges. (5) A woman in a black sleeveless top holds up a silver Acer Chromebook Plus Spin 514 on stage. She turns the laptop to demonstrate its thin profile and flexible hinge. The stage background features lush real and digital plants. (6) A man in a checkered blazer stands on stage gesturing with his hands as he speaks near a screen displaying 'Copilot Vision' and various creative app icons like Adobe Premiere and Figma. (7) Technical slides for Intel Panther Lake processors are shown, followed by a wide shot of the busy exhibition floor where visitors are interacting with laptops on wooden tables under bright fluorescent lighting. A stylized mascot overlay appears at the bottom for the sign-off.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female Chinese narration accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo electronic synthesizer BGM. The voice is clear and enthusiastic, with an expressive pitch contour. (2) As the scene transitions to the CEO on a scooter, a subtle digital whoosh SFX punctuates the cut. The music continues with a steady 4/4 electronic beat, maintaining a consistent high energy. (3) During the ESG presentation, the narrator's speech rate remains fast and informative. Background crowd murmurs are very faint, barely audible below the primary vocal and music track. (4) A brief clip of a male English speaker is integrated, sounding professional and authoritative with a slightly deeper pitch. The BGM ducks slightly to ensure clarity of the speech. (5) Transitioning to product highlights, another whoosh SFX is heard. The female narrator's arousal level increases when describing the 1kg laptop, using rising intonations for emphasis. (6) The final phase features a mix of the energetic female voice and a male speaker discussing Microsoft and Intel partnerships, ending with a cheerful sign-off as the BGM maintains its upbeat tempo through to the fade-out.
